info.title: API-DocTest-Create Telecom Sim Portability-v1-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Portability API enables seamless transfer of a mobile number from one service provider to another. This endpoint allows users to initiate the portability process, ensuring that their existing number can be retained during a switch. Primarily utilized by mobile carriers and service providers, it serves as a key tool for facilitating customer retention and satisfaction in the competitive telecom market. Developers can integrate this API to streamline the onboarding process for new customers, making transitions smoother and more efficient.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to start the process of transferring their mobile number from one service provider to another. It requires specific information about the user and their existing service provider to facilitate a smooth transition.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a portability operation for a SIM card. It contains the necessary details required for the operation to be processed accurately.
